questions.q: How do you open the Format pane for a number field in Tableau?
options: Right-click the field or number in the view and choose Format
Save the workbook and reopen it
Open the Extract dialog box
Double-click the workbook title
questions.explain: Right-clicking a field (or a number rendered in the view) and choosing Format opens the Format pane on the left side of the workspace.

questions.q: Which Numbers format options does the Format pane offer?
options: Automatic, Number (Standard/Custom), Currency (Standard/Custom), Scientific, Percentage, and Custom
Only Currency
Only whole numbers with no decimals allowed
Formatting only applies to text fields, not numbers
questions.explain: The Numbers dropdown covers a full range of standard and custom formats, including currency with locale selection.

questions.q: What is an axis, in Tableau's terms?
options: What a continuous field renders as — a scaled line of values
What a discrete field renders as — row or column labels
A type of calculated field
The name of the workbook's active worksheet
questions.explain: A continuous field produces an axis, which can be formatted with the same Numbers/Dates format options as any other field.

questions.q: What is a header, in Tableau's terms?
options: What a discrete field renders as — the labels for each member along rows or columns
The title bar of the Tableau Desktop application window
A continuous scale of numeric values
The Data pane's list of dimensions
questions.explain: Headers show the discrete members of a field — for example, each year or each sub-category name — as row or column labels.

questions.q: For a continuous or exact discrete date field, what does the Custom date format option let you do?
options: Build your own date pattern by combining format symbols (day, month, year, and so on)
Only choose between two fixed date presets
Convert the date field into a text string field
Disable date formatting entirely
questions.explain: The Custom option at the bottom of the date format list lets you combine Tableau's supported date format symbols into your own pattern.
